item.text: I’ll update `app/service.py` so `render_badge` accepts an optional human-readable `label` and uses it in the existing status `<span>` when present, while preserving the existing Badge return type and behavior otherwise. I’ll inspect the current implementation once, then apply a minimal patch.
I found `render_badge` already has the new parameter but currently rejects it. I’ll now implement label selection logic and keep the output span/class exactly as-is.

Implemented in [app/service.py](/workspace/app/service.py): - `render_badge` now uses `label` when provided: - `text = str(label if label is not None else code)` - It falls back to the numeric `code` when `label` is absent. - It returns the same `Badge` model with the existing status span format: `...`. - I also HTML-escaped the interpolated text to avoid unsafe markup in custom labels. If you want, I can run the public tests for this change next.
